version.description:
Leave the mouse on the desk. Sofatap turns your iPhone into a touchpad and keyboard for your own computer, including the one connected to your living-room TV.

MOVE, CLICK AND SCROLL
Slide one finger to move the pointer. Tap to click, double-tap for a right click, or hold for 0.3 seconds and move to drag. Scroll with two fingers or the strip inside the touchpad's right edge.

TYPE OR DICTATE
Use the iPhone keyboard or supported on-device dictation. Compatible native Windows and Mac text fields synchronize typing, edits and recognized speech as you go. Other fields use a draft you review and send. Sofatap does not append an extra Return after your text. Line breaks you include may be handled as Enter by the destination app.

SCAN, NAME, SWITCH
Install the Sofatap receiver and scan its QR code. Current receivers identify the device automatically. Save a name that makes sense to you, then switch between saved devices. You can rename or remove a pairing on your iPhone at any time.

YOUR DEVICES, DIRECTLY CONNECTED
Input travels over an encrypted connection on your local network. No Sofatap account, cloud relay, subscription or in-app purchase is required. Built-in dictation stays on the iPhone and requires a supported device and language. The computer's picture remains on its TV or monitor; Sofatap does not stream the screen.

REQUIREMENTS
An iPhone with iOS 17 or later and the free Sofatap receiver for Windows, Mac or Linux. Both devices must be on a reachable home network, and the computer must be awake and unlocked. Mac requires macOS 15 or later and Accessibility permission. Linux support depends on the desktop and its input permissions; Wayland is experimental. Unsupported fields, including many browser and custom controls, use review-and-send; Linux and older receivers use this mode.

LG webOS control in the app is a development preview; physical TV and app compatibility is not yet qualified. This version provides manual control, not autonomous AI operation.

Receiver downloads and setup:
https://github.com/chekusu/sofatap/releases/tag/v0.7.1-beta.1
https://github.com/chekusu/sofatap/blob/main/docs/app-store/support.md
version.promotionalText: Use your iPhone as a touchpad and keyboard for your computer. Scan to pair, name your devices, then tap, scroll, type or dictate from the sofa.

testFlight.description: Sofatap turns your iPhone into a touchpad and text-input surface for your own computer. Install the desktop receiver on the same home network, pair using its QR code, then use gestures, the iPhone keyboard or supported on-device dictation. A separate receiver is required; the computer must be awake and unlocked.
testFlight.whatToTest:
Test pairing with the receiver version provided for this beta. Confirm one-finger pointer movement, single-tap left click, double-tap right click, a 0.3-second hold followed by dragging, and two-finger scrolling.

In a supported native text field with a current receiver, test existing-text import, typing, emoji, newlines, Backspace, selection and Select All followed by deletion. Confirm changes reach the intended field without pressing Send. Test the microphone where local speech recognition is supported, including partial results and corrections.

In an unsupported field, on Linux, or with an older receiver, expect a review-and-send draft. Many browser and custom controls use this mode. Check the computer before retrying text after a lost connection. Also test denying and later enabling Camera, Local Network, Microphone and Speech permissions.

Report the phone/iOS version, receiver version, computer OS and destination application. Do not attach pairing QR codes, pairing links or private text.
